HARBOURVIEW CAPITAL PARTNERS III, L.P.
SIDE LETTER
Ref: HCP3-SL-017   ·   3 June 2024
To: Lantau Peak Family Office Ltd (for the Cheung Family Trust), Suite 3802, 38/F, Harbour Crest
Tower, 1 Harbour View Street, Central, Hong Kong (the "Investor")
Dear Investor,
In consideration of the Investor's commitment of USD 10,000,000 to Harbourview Capital Partners
III, L.P. (the "Fund"), the General Partner agrees the following terms, which prevail over the
Limited Partnership Agreement dated 15 May 2024 (the "LPA").
1.  COMMITMENT
1.1
The Investor's commitment is USD 10,000,000 (the "Commitment").
2.  MOST FAVOURED NATION
2.1
The Investor may elect the benefit of any more favourable fee terms granted to another
investor with an equal or smaller commitment.
3.  MANAGEMENT FEE
3.1
Notwithstanding clause 8.1 of the LPA, the management fee payable by the Investor shall be
calculated at the rate of 1.50% per annum of the Commitment (instead of 2.00% per annum)
for the whole term of the Fund.
3.2
The management fee is payable quarterly in advance on the first business day of each
calendar quarter.
3.3
No other fee rate applies to the Investor unless agreed in a further side letter signed by both
parties.
4.  REPORTING
4.1
Quarterly capital account statements within 60 days of each quarter end.
5.  WIRE INSTRUCTIONS
5.1
Capital calls and fees are paid to Atlantic Mercantile Bank, New York (SWIFT ATMBUS33),
account 8841-2207-5530. Changes are valid only by signed letter from the General Partner.
For the General Partner
Name:
Michael Tan, Managing Partner
Date:
3 Jun 2024
Agreed by the Investor
Name:
Victoria Cheung, Director

3 Jun 2024
